messages:
Sam Kaur: Hey all  first week question: where's the right place to post different onboarding problems (laptop shipping, VPN, service creds)? Also wondered which bots are safe to poke in channels vs which I should only DM.
Ethan Morales: welcome! Short map: laptop/shipping & HR -> #people-ops. VPN, infra access -> #eng-infra or open the SSO access ticket in #help. Service creds -> follow the secrets onboarding form (do not post in channels).
Priya Shah: If it's blocking you right now (can't get a shell or VPN), post in #help and ping @eng-oncall. That channel is watched and triages urgent access issues.
Sam Kaur: Good to know. What about bots? There's a cute polls bot in #random.
Ethan Morales: If the app is labeled sandbox or dev-friendly, it's fine. Otherwise, use #devex-sandbox for testing commands. Dont run unknown slash commands in public channels; treat them like installing an app.
Onboarding Bot: Hi Sam! To re-open your checklist, type `/onboard me` and I will DM you the remaining tasks. Use `/onboard status` to view progress.
IT Bot: For hardware or shipping changes, submit a ticket at https://peopleops.internal/tickets and include your manager and preferred delivery address.
Sam Kaur: Any quick posting etiquette so I don't flood channels?
Priya Shah: TL;DR: 1) Search first (handbook + Slack). 2) Post to the most specific channel (see pinned channel guide). 3) Use threads for follow-ups. 4) Paste concise logs in fenced code blocks. 5) Never paste secrets; rotate immediately if leaked.
Ethan Morales: Example for #eng: "@eng my build fails on ubuntu-22.04, ran `make build`, last 6 lines below" + fenced code block with the relevant lines. For long traces, use an unlisted gist or attach as a file.
Sam Kaur: If I accidentally post a secret, what's the exact flow?
Priya Shah: Delete the message, rotate the credential right away, then notify #eng-security. There's a pinned incident runbook in #eng-security for secret leaks.
Ethan Morales: One more thing: some channels are read-only because infra or monitoring integrations post there. Check channel purpose in the header before posting. If unsure, ask a channel admin or #help.
Sam Kaur: Thanks all  I'll use #help for blocking access issues and #devex-sandbox for bot tests. Appreciate the pointers :raised_hands:
